test_title: PYST 35: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 14 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been divided into four parts. One of them contains an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options.**

This boy / is cleverest / of all / in the class.
solution:
The correct answer is: **is cleverest**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the omission of the definite article "**the**" before "**cleverest**."
 
• When using **the superlative form** to indicate that someone or something has the highest degree of quality within a group, it's necessary to include the definite article "**the**."
 
• This helps specify that the individual being referred to is the most outstanding or best in comparison to all others in the group.
 
• The **corrected sentence** becomes: ***This boy is the__ cleverest of all in the class.***

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.
